note: Every change made to source text is listed here and logged by build_packs.py. Nothing is edited by hand in the packs.

rules.why: The source files put a space before punctuation that follows a tagged word or name.
The Hindi source appends cross-reference notes such as (2 Cor. 4:6) to verses. They are not scripture text.
A stray brace inside a word in the source.
The Hebrew New Testament marks verses it prints together with a reversed range marker such as ]73-63[. The marker is not text.
The sof pasuq (verse end mark) is attached to the last word in Hebrew; the source separates it with a space.
After the marker is removed, the second verse of a printed pair holds only the end mark. It is left empty because its text is in the first verse of the pair.
